title: Taco with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Outer tortilla shell, lit warm gold -->
    <path d='M14 66 Q10 40 30 24 Q50 10 70 24 Q90 40 86 66 Z' fill='#F2B233' stroke='#FFD66B' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- Slightly inner brighter shell rim -->
    <path d='M19 63 Q16 42 33 28 Q50 17 67 28 Q84 42 81 63 Z' fill='#FFD060'/>
    <!-- Filling base: meat, lit reddish brown -->
    <path d='M22 62 Q50 54 78 62 Q77 72 50 78 Q23 72 22 62 Z' fill='#C75B3A' stroke='#E8865E' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Green lettuce peeking out -->
    <path d='M20 60 Q28 52 36 58 Q42 50 50 57 Q58 49 65 57 Q73 51 80 60 Q74 66 66 62 Q58 68 50 62 Q42 68 34 62 Q26 66 20 60 Z' fill='#6FC93C' stroke='#9BE86A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Red tomato bits -->
    <circle cx='33' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#E83B3B'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='59' r='3.5' fill='#F04B4B'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#E83B3B'/>
    <!-- Yellow cheese dribble -->
    <path d='M40 64 Q44 70 48 65 Q52 71 56 64 Q60 70 62 64' fill='none' stroke='#FFE04D' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Face area: eyes on the tortilla -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
    <circle cx='39.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='63.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- Smiling mouth -->
    <path d='M38 49 Q50 58 62 49' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='2.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Cheeks -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='47' r='4' fill='#F58C8C' opacity='0.85'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='47' r='4' fill='#F58C8C' opacity='0.85'/>
  </g>
</svg>
